idea: Suggestion blocks — reviewer selects text and types replacement wording; agent applies it verbatim as a new comment type, no rewrite pass
rationale: Real, named friction (the nit-fix class of comment) collapsed from a full round to one action; reuses existing anchor/comment/diff machinery and doesn't cross the WYSIWYG-editor fence on inspection.

idea: Pre-flight self-review — agent scans its draft against standing preferences and silently pre-applies matching fixes before round 1 arms, annotated
rationale: Adds a new conditional branch to SKILL.md's already-flagged orchestration complexity, and the human's first view of a pre-flighted section is already post-fix, not pre-fix; scope down to a flag-and-confirm producer instead of silent pre-apply.
revisitCondition: SKILL.md's orchestration complexity is addressed structurally (PRODUCT.md's own Known Problems), or the auto-apply visibility concern is resolved some other way (e.g. a diff shown at first view, not just an annotation).
